mapper.select: select count(1) from basket_team t inner join basket_team_member m on m.team_id = t.id and m.is_delete = 0 where m.player_id = #{playerId} and m.role_type = 'CAPTAIN' and m.is_current = 1 and m.membership_status = 1 and t.team_status = 1 and t.is_delete = 0
select count(1) from basket_team_member where team_id = #{teamId} and is_current = 1 and membership_status = 1 and is_delete = 0

select id, membership_no, team_id, member_id, player_id, role_type, roster_type, jersey_no, join_source, membership_status, is_current, join_time, leave_time, leave_reason, remark, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_team_member where team_id = #{teamId} and role_type = 'CAPTAIN' and is_current = 1 and membership_status = 1 and is_delete = 0 limit 1

select t.id as teamId, t.team_no as teamNo, t.team_name as teamName, m.role_type as roleType, m.membership_status as membershipStatus, m.is_current as isCurrent, m.join_time as joinTime, t.audit_status as auditStatus from basket_team_member m inner join basket_team t on t.id = m.team_id and t.is_delete = 0 where m.member_id = #{memberId} and m.is_delete = 0 order by m.is_current desc, m.join_time desc

select m.member_id as memberId, m.player_id as playerId, coalesce(mp.nickname, p.game_nickname) as nickname, p.player_no as playerNo, m.role_type as roleType from basket_team_member m left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = m.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = m.player_id and p.is_delete = 0 where m.team_id = #{teamId} and m.is_current = 1 and m.membership_status = 1 and m.is_delete = 0 order by case when m.role_type = 'CAPTAIN' then 0 else 1 end, m.join_time asc

select count(1) from basket_team_member m inner join basket_team t on t.id = m.team_id and t.is_delete = 0 where m.player_id = #{playerId} and m.is_current = 1 and m.membership_status = 1 and m.is_delete = 0 and t.team_status = 1
